notes.title: Patch notes, version 1.1, May 20
notes.content:
Changelog v1.1
[list]
[*] added option to return to title via ESC key
[*] clarified some room descriptions
[*] increased performance
[*] fixed units deadlocking in same cases
[*] fixed crash related to entities without energy
[*] fixed scout being named adventurer
[*] fixed jobs being created if unit was not purchased
[/list]
